We’re an Indian startup building a more considered approach to knee support.

THE REASON WE BUILD

Everyday movement.
Extraordinary meaning.

A familiar walk. A daily routine. The next small step. Movement is personal.

Konarc is focused on people living with arthritis and knee problems. We’re bringing mechanical design and connected technology together to explore better ways of supporting everyday movement.

Our first product is a knee sleeve with adjustable mechanical support. Our vision extends to multiple connected sensors, a companion app, and future TENS integration.

We’re building that vision in stages, with a clear distinction between the first product and the technology still in development.
